description: Application view model for project users data (not stored as a database table), linked to crm projects, users.
business_purpose: Used to track and report project users records for the HR & User Management area.
record_granularity: One object represents one project user result row.

columns.name: Id
columns.description: Unique identifier of the project user.

columns.name: projectId
columns.description: Reference to the crm projects linked to this project user.

columns.name: userId
columns.description: Reference to the users linked to this project user.

columns.name: created_byId
columns.description: User who created the project user.

columns.name: created_date
columns.description: Date and time when the record was created.

columns.name: modified_byId
columns.description: User who last modified the project user.

columns.name: modified_date
columns.description: Date and time when the record was last modified.

columns.name: is_deleted
columns.description: Soft-delete flag. True when the record has been deleted.

relationships.description: Each project user references one crm projects (project).
Each project user references one users (user).
User who created the project user.
User who last modified the project user.

business_rules: Deleted records (is_deleted = 1) should normally be excluded from reporting.
created_date is the preferred date column for period-based reporting.
Join to CRM Projects, Users through the foreign key columns to resolve names.
ProjectUsers is an application view model or report DTO populated in code, not a table stored in the database.

query_notes: Do not generate SQL against ProjectUsers: no table or view with this name exists in the connected database.
Always filter is_deleted = 0 unless deleted records are explicitly requested.
Use COUNT(DISTINCT Id) when counting project user records; joins can duplicate rows.
To resolve names, join on: projectId = CRM_Projects.Id; userId = Users.Id.
Populated in application code (for example from a stored procedure or joined query); query the underlying tables instead.
